thread:
Alex S.: Heads-up — AcmeBank wants a short POC with BYOK + HSM attestation. Pen test scheduled for next Fri. They insist on zero-downtime rotation and <1m RTO. Any blockers?
Maria C.: Re: rotation — online rolling rotation is feasible if we use envelope encryption + HSM-backed KEKs. Need their expected QPS and average seq length to size cache rebuilds.
Lina (solutions): POC pricing heads-up: reserved HSM time + ephemeral session add-on. Rough ballpark: 4 HSM-hours/day for test traffic; will send a clearer estimate.
Matt (security): Security questionnaire flagged FIPS 140-3 attestation and key custody proof. We'll need to provide attestation artifacts and our KMS handshake diagram.
Alex S.: Dropping the handshake doc: <https://redwood.example/docs/byok-handshake> — presales-bot also posted runbook links.
presales-bot: Docs: https://redwood.example/docs/byok-handshake · Runbook: https://redwood.example/runbooks/key-rotation · Preflight: https://redwood.example/runbooks/preflight-checklist
Bob (acme): Quick question — during rotation, what's the RTO? Our internal SLA requires <1 minute for decryption availability.
Maria C.: <1m is tight but possible. With rolling double-write + 10% canary traffic we can validate key material before full cutover. Typical KV cache warmup for gen workload ~30s if cache hit rates are high.
Alex S.: They also asked if we support ephemeral KEKs (short-lived customer KEKs) for added crypto separation.
Lina (solutions): Yes — supported via delegated HSM sessions. Billing: ephemeral sessions billed per session + minor throughput charge. I'll add conservative numbers to the SOW for now.
Matt (security): Confirming constraints: customer requires no plaintext on disk, rotation audit trail retained 365 days, and cryptographic attestations for HSM manufacturing. Can we commit?
Maria C.: No plaintext persisted. Rotation events and hashes of key wraps are logged to the audit trail. We can provide exported audit snippets and an attestation package for FIPS/HSM vendor certs.
Alex S.: Can someone paste the minimal config snippet we should include in the SOW for rotation settings?
Maria C.: Sure — put this in the appendix:
```
redwood:
  kms:
    mode: customer_managed
    rotation:
      strategy: rolling
      canary_percent: 10
      window_seconds: 120
```
Lina (solutions): I'll update the SOW and price the ephemeral sessions. One operational blocker: pen-test needs allowlist + test creds by Tue to meet Fri window.
Alex S.: I'll request allowlist and test creds from Acme today and loop infra for firewall exceptions. :thumbsup:
presales-bot: Reminder: run the preflight checklist and upload artifacts to the deal folder: https://redwood.example/deals/ACME-POC/preflight
Alex S.: Thanks all — will follow up with timeline and SOW draft tomorrow.
